items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I used to catch Pettiford and tear him up... after that now, he kept soloing and on I didn't. So when I became the house man at Birdland... every night that Pettiford could, he'd come down there with his bass... and I'd take my bass and go right off

ctx.x: Oh, I see. They resented you -- resented you.

Yeah, that position. That's why -- in those -- I went to 52nd Street, I refused to take any solos. For a long time a guy who said, 'Take a solo,' I said, 'No, I'm in the rhythm section.' I thought that maybe I could -- would be in a peaceful manner rather than that, because before that I used to catch Pettiford and tear him up, you know?
